results.title: Sandisk & SK hynix Standardize HBF: A New Memory Tier ...
results.content:
Key-value cache is one of the most important memory challenges in large-language-model inference. During autoregressive generation, transformer models store key and value tensors from previous tokens. This avoids recomputing attention over the entire context. As context windows become longer, KV cache memory requirements grow significantly. [...] HBM is the correct place for the most active KV cache data. However, not all session history is equally active. Older cache blocks or less frequently accessed context may be candidates for tiering. DRAM and HBF can support overflow or warm-cache strategies if software can manage migration intelligently. [...] The challenge is latency management. If the system moves data out of HBM and then needs it immediately, performance may suffer. Therefore, KV cache tiering requires prediction, scheduling, and prefetching. A standardized HBF layer can help by giving software developers a clear target for optimization.
